reviews.text: I really like what I got from the one time fee for pro. Allows me to share a dog w other people who didn't purchase pro, and can still contribute and the interface is easy to work with. Love that I can set a default dog, and can reorg the activities to what I want to see and customize the types of training activities to better track progress. Love it! great value!

Got the wrong amount of months.it was 5 months by the time I brought her home , but I was unable to change it. Tried a different E-mail. Didn't work. Not sure if it's because of the phone #. Going to uninstall.
reviews.reply: Hi We are sorry to hear you’re having issues signing in. Could you please reach out to us at help@kidplay.app and we’ll help you resolve the problem?

reviews.text: I downloaded the app today and started to log our puppy's activities. I was impressed with the features it had for a free app until less than 12 hours after installing it I received a pop-up saying my free experience was ending soon. Don't list as a free app if it's subscription only.
Just what I needed to get my two pitbull puppies under control

Update: This app was fantastic. However, I recently switched phones and have had trouble accessing the app. I have been trying for several months to get back into my subscription, and the management team has been utterly useless in making this work. I pay $5/month for the features and can't even get a message back to help me login. I was really enjoying everything about this app, but the lack of customer service from a team I'm paying $5/mo is horrifying. Would recommend finding a different app.

I bought this so I could coordinate puppy activities with my husband, and we're on our second puppy now. There are some sync issues, but eventually the other person's log will show up. It's not a replacement for communication, but I like using it to track "business" schedules and weight gain.

Had it for 3 days, logged 29 events, went to log in a 30th when it asked me to pay for the subscription. It refuses to let me log in anything else rendering this app useless. I'd have preferred if I was given a heads up like "3 day free trial!" or even asking to subscribe at the beginning so my time would not be wasted.

I'm currently training a service dog for myself and she's also a tiny puppy at the moment and she's going through the puppy tummy troubles. This app is critical to helping me with so many aspects of her care. I've tried a few and this was the one I stuck with.
We have been enjoying the app to track our new puppies patterns. Has been really helpful thus far. Sometimes, the sync between users takes a while, but a little patience, and it eventually shows up.

Paid to upgrade but the app has now stopped working. It won't sync with my partner anymore. I can't see anything that he has logged. It keeps telling me that I need to upgrade to unlock features that I have already paid for. It keeps signing me out and then the code to sign in doesn't work. It will randomly start working, last about half a day, and then stop working again. I have sent multiple messages to the "help" which appears to be just one man called "David" and have been completely ignored
Very good app overall. Only problem is sometimes events added by my partner are not synced even after a few hours and the app requires a force close and re-open to display them

It says no log in required but after 5 or 6 days, it forces you to create an account and then forces you to subscribe monthly or annually. If you don't subscribe, then the app stops working and won't let you log any more activities.

Awesome app especially for mapping out a potty schedule for young puppies. You can have it set smart reminders, like everytime you record a pee it can be set up to make a reminder X amount of time after. Same for all things you can track. Exceptional!

The application is incredibly straightforward to use and adding events is pretty easy. 5 stars when we get widgets for the home screen, that is the only thing I'm missing and smartwatch integration would be amazing!

Great app, makes most of what I want to do for tracking my puppy very simple. Would love if there were a web version, if the time format followed system settings, and there was an easier way to log "nap started", "nap ended" than by going into the sleep item and changing the end time. Oh, and the fact that the app stops working unless you buy a subscription after 20 events with no warning is pretty annoying.

We use this to coordinate the care for our dog. We have different schedules, but want to make sure puppy gets everything on a consistent schedule without having to guess what was already done. Some recommendations for the dev team: automatically open today's date, to be able to schedule interval reminders (every other day) as well as day of the week. Also, once the reminder has been addressed, it would be nice that the red dot turns green so we know it was done without scrolling through.
This app is probably great if you use it on a single device, but if you pay for the shared logs you'll be highly disappointed. Don't pay for the upgrade. The syncing functionality does not work.
Wonderful pet app to track your pet. Easy to use.
Great tool to keep track of a puppy's activities and tell things like how much they sleep or when was the last potty break.
Love app but wish could track how long naps and when not just tallied

App use to work great with just ads, but now requires payment to log/track any activities. Won't allow me to track anything without payment. I don't see anything on the apps information page that states this only works after if it's paid for, so please update info if this is the case. If this is just a glitch, please fix and I would be happy to adjust my rating and continue to use. For now, will look elsewhere for dog tracking and attempt to pull over the months of information I've logged here.
After the update on 9/26, I keep getting the advertisement to pay for the app. It is not letting me load any of the activities for the day. It used to be free what happened?
Not easy to access past activities and timelines. Have to go back to the date of activity to view.

Can not login all of a sudden- verification codes will not work on an android s22 for some reason. Have uninstalled and resinstalled to no avail. App is useless now as our household shares the account for our puppy to track her and it can't sync.
Very useful app. Paid the one time subscription to avoid ads and would recommend.
Really practical app when you have a puppy. It has helped us immensely!
Incredibly helpful in getting your puppy trained and keeping a healthy daily routine!

Promises to be a great app Paid for the upgrade, but it doesn't yet give me the comparisons that I expected (time between food and poo, water and drink) I miss a widget so I can more quickly record the basics without multiple steps and constantly having the app open. The developers reacted quickly to both my support requests, but at this point I would not have paid the upgrade if it had been clear the comparisons I need were not there
Just one facet to training and developing a great dog. This is a fantastic addition to it all. Superb app.
Brilliant for creating a schedule for our puppy and fun to use.
